about: The day we first saw each leaderboard score that a board posted after we started reading it. Written by scripts/first-seen.ts after each sync. Rows we had on the `since` day, rows that came with a board on the day we first read it, and rows of a model on the day it joined the catalog are not listed: they keep their model release date.
